segment: Pins for the product's own V3 source-update transaction on the serving home are fully recovered and verified; the transaction itself is the next executable step

why_the_pins_were_missing.fact: the project repository's overlay manifests were rewritten by commit ab5cb0c (184-layer bundle restore): the 11 manifests listed below were re-serialised (key order normalised, 'prerequisites' added, 'expected_patched_files' folded into 'files'). Their bytes changed, so the serving home's source receipt still pins the previous bytes of exactly those 11 manifests.
why_the_pins_were_missing.consequence: a product update transaction on the serving home would fail composition_checked ('composition_overlay_manifest_changed') because the receipt's manifest_sha256 values no longer match the repository copies - even though the layer semantics (files list, patch, patch_sha256) are identical for all 11.
why_the_pins_were_missing.layers_with_matching_semantics: verified: for all 11 the 'files' list and 'patch'/'patch_sha256' are byte-identical between the recovered generation and the repository; only serialisation and an added prerequisite map differ.

recovery.method: the previous generation's exact manifest and patch bytes were located by content hash in the local candidate caches (not by name), and copied to /home/jericho/.cache/FRW-V3-OLD-MANIFESTS-20261108/patches/hermes
recovery.verification: all 180 manifest digests and all 180 patch digests of the serving home's source receipt are reproduced exactly by that directory (180/180 verified)
recovery.layer_order: the serving home's layer ORDER differs from the repository's canonical overlay order (the cli-launcher-no-bytecode layer sits at index 32 in the home and at index 2 in the canonical order) and the repository's canonical order equals the installed V3 composition's receipt order exactly (184/184) - the same commutation the product's bundle_layer_prefix_checked already encodes as a proven exception
recovery.v3_prefix: the three source157 manifests' installed_prefix is exactly the serving home's layers[0:179] map (verified equal), i.e. the prefix a transaction on this home must present

next_executable_step.action: run the product's update-telegram transaction for the four reviewed V3 layers (source157-original-context-deterministic-overhead, source157-bounded-schema-hints, source157-tool-budget-fit, write-file-format-guard) against the serving home, with the gateway stopped on the safe boundary; the transaction's own receipt/stamp/marker publication, journaling and rollback are used, no hand-written state
next_executable_step.preconditions_already_proved: the four patches apply cleanly to the serving home's source files in order and every resulting file digest equals the installed V3 composition's receipt entries; the container table is empty and no receiver other than the single gateway is running
next_executable_step.verification_after: source receipt 180 -> 184 layers with the four reviewed manifests, composition_checked against the repository, ordinary gateway check, then restart the single gateway and confirm Telegram plus both user profiles
